title: Massachusetts pharmacy technician scope and pharmacist responsibility
rule_summary: Pharmacy technicians and trainees may perform only duties allowed by 247 CMR 8 under pharmacist supervision; judgmental pharmacist functions may not be delegated.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply technician duties requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.

authority.name: Massachusetts pharmacy technician scope and pharmacist responsibility

exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing technician duties with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
